Title: Updated API Help page available for Azure Machine Learning

Body.Content: The April 8 release of Azure Machine Learning includes several improvements, including the ability to copy experiments across workspaces, define a location for the results produced by a batch request, an updated API Help page, and a new Permutation Feature Importance module. For details on the release, please visit the Machine Learning Support Forum.
